title: villa's tifxyz to OBJ mesh exporter (vc_tifxyz2obj)

native.vc3d_action: VC3D runs it from its segment context menu (export a segment as OBJ, and the flatten round trip)

notes: Listed so the command line and agents see villa's own tools; the registry never runs them. VC3D runs it from its own segment context menu (OBJ export and the SLIM flatten round trip), so no plugin item duplicates it; no AutoPipeline stage calls it.
